tagline.en: A world model that extends VGGT's grounded 3D geometry toward video generation and 3D scene understanding.
tagline.zh: 在 VGGT 三维几何基础上,向视频生成与三维场景理解延伸的世界模型。

en: VGGT-World is a world model that builds on the VGGT line of grounded 3D geometry. Where VGGT recovers 3D structure from images, VGGT-World pushes toward generation and understanding — connecting 3D scene reasoning with video generation.

It is distributed as upstream research source. In WorldFoundry the source and configuration are registered so you can resolve its model zoo config and inference route; the checkpoints and assets are staged separately, and the runtime lists what it needs.
Treat it as a research entry point for combining 3D scene understanding with world-model-style video generation.
zh: VGGT-World 是一个世界模型,建立在 VGGT 系列的三维几何之上。VGGT 从图像恢复三维结构,而 VGGT-World 则进一步走向生成与理解——把三维场景推理和视频生成联系起来。
它以上游研究源码形式发布。在 WorldFoundry 中,其源码与配置已被注册,你可以解析它的模型库配置与推理路径;checkpoint 与素材需另行准备,运行时会列出所需内容。
可把它当作把三维场景理解与世界模型式视频生成结合起来的研究入口。

whenToUse.en: Use VGGT-World when you want to experiment with a world model that ties 3D scene understanding to video generation, and you can stage its source and checkpoints.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想试验一个把三维场景理解与视频生成结合起来的世界模型,并能准备其源码与 checkpoint 时,适合使用 VGGT-World。

notFor.en: It is a research codebase rather than a ready-made pipeline; you must download and stage checkpoints and assets before real generation.
notFor.zh: 它更像研究代码库而非现成流程;真实生成前需自行下载并准备好 checkpoint 与素材。

en: Extends VGGT-style grounded 3D geometry into a world model
Bridges 3D scene understanding and video generation
zh: 把 VGGT 式的三维几何延伸为世界模型
连接三维场景理解与视频生成
以上游研究源码形式发布
